Name: (CP) Harvey in Shipping Bin
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
With this mod, Harvey will hide in your shipping bin. He was coming to make a house call, only to get ambushed by your resident slimes! ...He swears he saw slimes! Let him hide a little longer?

~~

Requested by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/casualratmandoug/about-me?gameId=1303]casualratmandoug[/url]!

Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65]JG Demetrius in Shipping Box mod[/url], this mod adds Harvey into your shipping bin. When you ship an item, he'll pop out and back inside. Purely cosmetic and for fun; rest assured that your products and profits are entirely safe.

Works with buildable shipping bins around the farm, and overlays over other shipping bin colors--like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1554]Eemie's Dark Wood[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1904]my Burnt Sienna[/url]~

Note however that this mod does [b]not [/b]work with anything that affects the shipping bin animation itself--such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿. 



[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and give poor Harvey a hug!
